If I could give Jen 6 stars I would! I’ve taken many classes with Jen. Puppy, beginner, 3 private lessons, 1 out and about class, and soon to do intermediate. Baymax is extremely stubborn, reactive, the works, but Jen has not once given up on him and reminds us constantly not to as well. The care she puts towards Baymax is like no other. She tests him in levels I was afraid to and now we’ve seen so much improvement in him.

Realized I never wrote a review until now so I’m expressing my gratitude. Thanks Jen!!

This review is a few years late, but I have recommended Jen to multiple friends now and they’ve all had positive experiences.

As a new dog owner in 2021, I took my 16 month old rescue, Maverick, to receive basic and intermediate obedience training from Jen. I learned early on that my rescue had high anxiety. So with Jen’s observation and guidance during the group classes, she gave me additional tips on how to work with my dog’s anxiety and tendency to pull - and after putting them to practice, there was tremendous improvement in my dog’s confidence and obedience.

At first, I thought if there were any issues with me or my dog, it might get missed in a group setting, but that’s far from true. Jen uses the group to further benefit the development of the dog’s obedience, and the exercises are designed to watch every owner and their dog, and she is quick to make useful suggestions.

As one example, my dog was acting out during one group exercise, so Jen stepped in, advised me to hand the leash to her, and had me walk around the group circle without my dog. My dog’s focus immediately switched, like a light bulb, and from then on, his acceptance of my leadership was established. I can’t explain how, but I remember that as the moment my dog and I had formed a bond.

We have continued to practice obedience exercises we learned years ago for 5-10 minutes a day as it’s just a normal part of our relationship now. While his anxiety isn’t fully gone - by nature he’s very protective - he’s able to listen to me and receive my instruction at a moment’s notice thanks to the training we received.

If anyone is looking for a trainer, I’d highly recommend Top Dog Canine.
